messages:
Ravi Singh: FYI: Private/VPC 2.2.1 (privacy + compliance updates) is officially released to internal GA. This release focuses on per-tenant residency controls, the Audit API v1, and a tightened default privacy profile for new installs. Rolling customer invites start next Tue. :party-popper:
Hannah Li: Quick notes for Sales & CSMs: upgrade is low-risk for most customers but on-prem customers with custom networking may need a 10-15 minute maintenance window. We'll provide an "express upgrade" assistance slot for enterprise customers.
Claire B.: Security summary: Audit API v1 supports append-only event streams, HMAC-signed entries, and export to S3/syslog. We added a new scoped role redwood.audit_reader. Rotation events from HSMs now record key-id and rotation-timestamp in the audit record. Customers using customer-managed HSMs must acknowledge rotation automation in the installer flow.
Markus G.: Engineering ops: online upgrade path preserves runtime cache; expected per-node upgrade time ~25-40m depending on model cache size. For agents earlier than v1.9, run the migration helper before upgrade: 
```
# on customer node
sudo redwood-agent preflight --ensure v1.9
sudo redwood-agent migrate --backup /var/tmp/agent-pre-{ts}.tgz
```
If anything goes sideways, rollback is supported to the immediate prior image via the controller UI.
Ravi Singh: Messaging guidance: customer-facing blurb should highlight "Configurable residency and auditable logs with minimal maintenance." Avoid heavy legalese. Keep it under two lines. Hannah + Claire, can you approve wording by EOD Monday?
Hannah Li: Approved draft for email header: "Private 2.2.1: Residency & Audit Controls — Easy upgrade, stronger controls." I'll post full email template in the marketing folder.
Claire B.: Added compliance checklist to the runbook: attestation steps, sample S3 bucket policy, syslog config, and rotation opt-in examples. Also added a sample API payload for changing retention: 
```
PATCH /audit/config
{
  "retention_days": 90,
  "export_targets": ["s3://company-audit-bucket"]
}
```
ops-bot: Release timeline updated: 2.2.1 internal GA -> 1939004000, staged cohort rollouts -> 1939089600. Runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/private-2-2-1-upgrade (rev:2).
Ravi Singh: Action items: 1) Legal & Security: finalize customer text (Claire + Legal) 2) Solutions: prepare 30-min upgrade assistance offer (Hannah) 3) Eng: smoke-test air-gapped bundles and confirm installer flag --telemetry=off (Markus). Please confirm here when done. :white_check_mark:
